semiconductor_relevance: High — Advantec Co., Ltd. provides essential semiconductor materials and wafers, catering to the high-tech semiconductor market.
summary: Advantec Co., Ltd. specializes in supplying a variety of bare and patterned wafers, as well as semiconductor materials, to meet the growing demands of the semiconductor industry in Taiwan. Established to enhance local market resources, the company offers products tailored for high-tech applications.
capabilities: Target materials including Ta, Si, and Ge

regional_presence.Taiwan: Advantec Co., Ltd. operates through its subsidiary, Triomax Technologies Ltd., to serve the local semiconductor market.
